# Lav P. Patel — Manager, Data and AI Architecture

> Lav P. Patel is Manager, Data and AI Architecture at the University of Kansas Medical Center (KUMC), where he architected and shipped CareScriptMD — an AI-powered clinical documentation platform. He is an EB-1 Extraordinary Ability holder with 24 peer-reviewed publications, 1,031 citations, and an h-index of 17.

## Work Experience

**Manager, Data and AI Architecture** — University of Kansas Medical Center (KUMC) (Jan 2025 – Present)
- Architected and shipped CareScriptMD — an AI clinical documentation platform using Whisper, Claude, and Llama within HIPAA-compliant infrastructure
- Sole technical builder collaborating with Jeff Burns, MD (PI)
- Navigated dual-track institutional compliance — secured IRB approval and cleared regulatory path for clinical AI deployment

**Senior Team Lead — Biomedical Informatics Software Engineer** — KUMC (Feb 2021 – Jan 2025)
- Led a 10-engineer team building enterprise biomedical informatics systems
- Architected COVID-19 data pipeline connecting ~10 hospitals in 7 days (typical: 1.5 months)
- Drove a 20-publication research program as head of the Knowledge Discovery Team
- Built OMOP CDM from scratch for the AllofUs Heartland consortium

**Team Lead — Biomedical Informatics Software Engineer | Solutions Architect** — KUMC (Aug 2020 – Feb 2021)
- Delivered 47x performance improvement on PCORnet CDM pipeline (233 hours → 5 hours), CDC/NIH/FDA/PCORI funded

**Biomedical Informatics Software Engineer | Data Engineer** — KUMC (Feb 2019 – Aug 2020)
- Optimized department ETL process from 28 days to 7 days
- Debugged i2b2 open-source clinical data warehouse for sub-second query performance

**Senior Enterprise Systems Engineer | DevOps Engineer** — KUMC (Sep 2017 – Feb 2019)
- Owned security and governance for 21M+ Medicare/Medicaid patient records — zero breaches
- Shipped federated query infrastructure across 50+ hospitals in 15 days

**Enterprise Systems Engineer | Distributed Backend Systems** — KUMC (Dec 2016 – Sep 2017)
